identification: Three carded Australian George V florins: 1915 (shown as plain, no visible H; London/Heaton question to check), 1917M, 1919M. Sterling .925 silver, all well circulated about fine. 1915 has a rust stain across card and coin. Seller's 'low mintage, scarce' notes are optimistic: 1915 florins turn up routinely in Noble lots.

viewing_check: Look under the date on the 1915 reverse for a small H (Heaton) mintmark, confirm the seller's 'plain/London' claim, and check grade and the extent of the rust stain. Confirm 1917 and 1919 carry M (Melbourne). Check for cleaning or damage.
